parole.significato: The madder of the Levant; wild madder (Rubia peregrina).
parole.testo: From French alizari (“madder root (commercial name)”), from Greek αλιζάρι (alizári, “madder”), from Ottoman Turkish آلاجهری (ala cehri).

parole.significato: A very toxic, colorless crystalline alkaloid, derived from nux vomica, used as a pesticide.
parole.testo: From French strychnine, from Greek στρύχνος (strýchnos, “sleepy nightshade”) (or directly from Ancient Greek στρύχνον (strúkhnon)) + -ine.
